Conflict And Social Centralization In Tairona Chiefdom Communities In The Río Frío Basin, Sierra Nevada De Santa Marta, Colombia

Geospatial data sets associated with the Regional Archaeology Program of the Río Frío Basin

Syntax written by Luis Miguel Soto Rodríguez , Ph.D. student at the University of Pittsburgh on January 24, 2025

1. Definition of the working environment

if (!requireNamespace("git2r", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("git2r")
}
library(git2r)
repo_url <- "https://github.com/luismiguelsoto/Conflict_And_Social_Centralization_In_Tairona_Chiefdom_Communities.git"
temp_repo <- file.path(tempdir(), "Conflict_And_Social_Centralization_In_Tairona_Chiefdom_Communities")
if (!dir.exists(temp_repo)) {
  clone(repo_url, local_path = temp_repo)
}

2. Data Loading and Spatial Object Definition

dem_path     <- file.path(dir_gis, "DEM_UNTIL_2023.tif")
sites_path   <- file.path(dir_gis, "CENTROID_SITES_TAIRONA.shp")
polygon_path <- file.path(dir_gis, "POLYGON_SURVEY_UNTILL_2023.shp")
DEM_raw     <- rast(dem_path)
sites_orig  <- vect(sites_path)
survey_poly <- vect(polygon_path)
cat("CRS DEM:", crs(DEM_raw), "\n")

3. Optimization of Viewpoints for Archaeological Sites

dem_crop <- crop(DEM_raw, ext(survey_poly))
DEM      <- mask(dem_crop, survey_poly)

sites_orig$ZID <- seq_len(nrow(sites_orig))

buff_100m <- buffer(sites_orig, width = 100)
zones_r   <- rasterize(buff_100m, DEM, field = "ZID")
zstats    <- zonal(DEM, zones_r, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)
zmax_r    <- classify(zones_r, rcl = zstats, include.lowest = FALSE, others = NA)

r_equals <- (DEM == zmax_r)
r_equals[is.na(r_equals)] <- 0
r_equals[r_equals == 0]   <- NA

obs_points_raw <- as.points(r_equals)
obs_points_raw_sf <- st_as_sf(obs_points_raw)
buff_100m_sf <- st_as_sf(buff_100m)

if (is.na(st_crs(obs_points_raw_sf)$proj4string)) {
  st_crs(obs_points_raw_sf) <- st_crs(survey_poly)
}
if (is.na(st_crs(buff_100m_sf)$proj4string)) {
  st_crs(buff_100m_sf) <- st_crs(survey_poly)
}

target_crs <- st_crs(survey_poly)
obs_points_raw_sf <- st_transform(obs_points_raw_sf, target_crs)
buff_100m_sf <- st_transform(buff_100m_sf, target_crs)

obs_points_atts_sf <- st_intersection(obs_points_raw_sf, buff_100m_sf)
df_atts <- as.data.frame(obs_points_atts_sf, geom = "XY")

df_unique <- df_atts %>% group_by(ZID) %>% slice(1L)
df_unique_sf <- st_as_sf(df_unique)
coords <- st_coordinates(df_unique_sf)
df_unique$x <- coords[, 1]
df_unique$y <- coords[, 2]

sites_optimized <- vect(df_unique, geom = c("x", "y"), crs = crs(DEM))
sites_optimized$SiteID <- df_unique$ZID

n_sites <- nrow(sites_optimized)
offset <- 1.6
radius <- 10000
curv_coef <- 6 / 7

cumul_rast <- DEM
values(cumul_rast) <- 0

for (i in seq_len(n_sites)) {
  si_i <- sites_optimized[i, ]
  loc_xy <- as.numeric(crds(si_i))
  
  buff_10km <- buffer(si_i, width = radius)
  
  vs_raw <- viewshed(
    x = DEM,
    loc = loc_xy,
    observer = offset,
    target = 0,
    curvcoef = curv_coef,
    output = "yes/no"
  )
  
  vs_mask_poly <- mask(vs_raw, survey_poly)
  vs_limited <- mask(vs_mask_poly, buff_10km)
  
  visible_count <- 0
  for (j in seq_len(n_sites)) {
    if (j == i) next
    si_j <- sites_optimized[j, ]
    val_j <- terra::extract(vs_limited, si_j)[, 2]
    if (!is.na(val_j) && val_j == 1) {
      visible_count <- visible_count + 1
    }
  }
  
  sites_optimized$NumSitesVisible[i] <- visible_count
  
  tmp <- vs_limited
  tmp[is.na(tmp)] <- 0
  cumul_rast <- cumul_rast + tmp
}

calcular_X <- function(Y, Z, intercept, coef_X, coef_Z) {
  (Y - intercept + (coef_Z * Z)) / coef_X
}

modal_fun <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

find_threshold <- function(prop_values, desired_min_no = 1) {
  sorted_vals <- sort(prop_values, na.last = NA)
  for (th in sorted_vals) {
    classification <- ifelse(prop_values >= th, "Yes", "No")
    count_no <- sum(classification == "No", na.rm = TRUE)
    if (count_no >= desired_min_no) return(th)
  }
  NA
}

6. Lines of Sight (LOS): EDA, Welch ANOVA y post-hoc

los_path <- file.path(dir_db, "LINES_OF_SIGHT_TYPE_SITES.csv")
out_dir  <- file.path(dir_db, "outputs")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

suppressWarnings({
  LOS <- tryCatch(
    {
      readr::read_delim(los_path, delim = ";",
                        locale = readr::locale(decimal_mark = ","), show_col_types = FALSE)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      readr::read_delim(los_path, delim = ";",
                        locale = readr::locale(decimal_mark = "."), show_col_types = FALSE)
    }
  )
})

names(LOS) <- gsub("\\s+", "_", names(LOS))

cand_len <- intersect(tolower(names(LOS)), c("length","longitud","length_km","km","dist_km"))
stopifnot("No encuentro columna de longitudes (Length/Longitud/Length_km)." = length(cand_len) >= 1)
len_col <- names(LOS)[match(cand_len[1], tolower(names(LOS)))]
LOS[[len_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(LOS[[len_col]]))

cand_grp <- intersect(tolower(names(LOS)), c("source","sourcetype","sitetype","type","grupo"))
stopifnot("No encuentro columna de grupos (Source/SiteType/Type)." = length(cand_grp) >= 1)
grp_col <- names(LOS)[match(cand_grp[1], tolower(names(LOS)))]

LOS <- LOS %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[len_col]])) %>% mutate(!!grp_col := as.factor(.data[[grp_col]]))

desc_stats <- LOS %>%
  group_by(.data[[grp_col]]) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean   = mean(.data[[len_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(.data[[len_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(.data[[len_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR    = IQR(.data[[len_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(.data[[len_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(.data[[len_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))

readr::write_csv(desc_stats, file.path(out_dir, "LOS_descriptivos.csv"))
print(desc_stats)

7. Site Attribute Calculations

elevaciones <- terra::extract(dem, vect(sites), fun = mean)
sites$elevation <- elevaciones[, 2]
sites$Size_HA <- as.numeric(st_area(sites)) / 10000
sites$Size_Class <- cut(sites$Size_HA, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, Inf),
                        labels = c("Small_sites", "Medium_sites", "Large_sites"))

prop_defensible <- terra::extract(area_defensible, vect(sites), fun = mean)
sites$prop_defensible <- prop_defensible[, 2]

umbral <- 0.05
sites$in_defensible <- ifelse(is.na(sites$prop_defensible), "No",
                              ifelse(sites$prop_defensible >= umbral, "Yes", "No"))
if (sum(sites$in_defensible == "No", na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  umbral_ajustado <- find_threshold(sites$prop_defensible, desired_min_no = 1)
  if (!is.na(umbral_ajustado)) {
    sites$in_defensible <- ifelse(is.na(sites$prop_defensible), "No",
                                  ifelse(sites$prop_defensible >= umbral_ajustado, "Yes", "No"))
    message(paste("Adjusted threshold for 'No':", umbral_ajustado))
  } else {
    warning("No threshold found to yield at least one 'No'. All remain as 'Yes'.")
  }
}

total_sites_by_size <- table(sites$Size_Class)
defensible_sites_by_size <- table(sites$Size_Class[sites$in_defensible == "Yes"])

if (sum(defensible_sites_by_size) > 0) {
  percentages <- (defensible_sites_by_size / sum(defensible_sites_by_size)) * 100
} else {
  percentages <- rep(0, length(defensible_sites_by_size))
}

df_percentages <- data.frame(Categoria = names(percentages),
                             Porcentaje = as.numeric(percentages))
ggplot(df_percentages, aes(x = Categoria, y = Porcentaje, fill = Categoria)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.2) +
  ggtitle("Percentage of Sites in Defensible Areas by Size") +
  xlab("Size Category") +
  ylab("Percentage in Defensible Area") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "lightgreen", "salmon")) +
  theme_classic()

contingency_table <- table(sites$Size_Class, sites$in_defensible)
chi_result <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
print(chi_result)
## 
##  Pearson's Chi-squared test
## 
## data:  contingency_table
## X-squared = 11, df = 2, p-value = 0.004
assoc_stats <- assocstats(contingency_table)
cramers_v <- assoc_stats$cramer
print(paste("Cramer's V:", round(cramers_v, 3)))
## [1] "Cramer's V: 0.178"
observed <- contingency_table[, "Yes"]
expected <- chi_result$expected[, "Yes"]
df_comparison <- data.frame(
  Categoria = rownames(contingency_table),
  Observado = as.numeric(observed),
  Esperado = as.numeric(expected)
)

ggplot(df_comparison, aes(x = Categoria)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Observado, color = "Observed", group = 1), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Observado, color = "Observed"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = Observado, label = Observado, color = "Observed"), 
            vjust = -1, size = 3.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Esperado, color = "Expected", group = 1), 
            linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = Esperado, color = "Expected"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = Esperado, label = Esperado, color = "Expected"), 
            vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Values", 
                     values = c("Observed" = "blue", "Expected" = "orange")) +
  labs(title = "Observed vs Expected Comparison", 
       x = "Size Category", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_classic()

8. Structural Change and Baseline Comparison Analysis

bootstrap_median_narrow <- function(x, n_bootstrap = 10000, conf_level = 0.80) {
  boot_medians <- replicate(n_bootstrap, median(sample(x, replace = TRUE)))
  lower <- quantile(boot_medians, (1 - conf_level) / 2)
  upper <- quantile(boot_medians, 1 - (1 - conf_level) / 2)
  median_value <- median(boot_medians)
  return(data.frame(median = median_value, lower = lower, upper = upper))
}

9. Classification of Sites Based on Standard Deviations

study_area_path <- file.path(dir_gis, "POLYGON_SURVEY_UNTILL_2023.shp")
sites_path      <- file.path(dir_gis, "SITES_VIEWSHED.shp")

study_area <- sf::st_read(study_area_path, quiet = TRUE)
sites      <- sf::st_read(sites_path, quiet = TRUE)

if (sf::st_crs(sites) != sf::st_crs(study_area)) {
  sites <- sf::st_transform(sites, sf::st_crs(study_area))
}

sem_data <- sites |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ViewArea_k), !is.na(NUMPOINTS))

neighbors    <- spdep::poly2nb(sem_data, queen = TRUE, snap = 100)
## Warning in spdep::poly2nb(sem_data, queen = TRUE, snap = 100): some observations have no neighbours;
## if this seems unexpected, try increasing the snap argument.
## Warning in spdep::poly2nb(sem_data, queen = TRUE, snap = 100): neighbour object has 108 sub-graphs;
## if this sub-graph count seems unexpected, try increasing the snap argument.
weights_list <- spdep::nb2listw(neighbors, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

sem_model <- spatialreg::errorsarlm(
  NUMPOINTS ~ ViewArea_k, data = sem_data,
  listw = weights_list, zero.policy = TRUE
)

sem_data$sem_residuals <- residuals(sem_model)

p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", which_north = "true",
    style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering,
    height = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"), width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm")
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = study_area, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = sem_data, ggplot2::aes(fill = sem_residuals),
                   color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B7FB8", mid = "#F0F0F0", high = "#D73027",
    midpoint = 0, name = "SEM Residuals", na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_void() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8)
  )

ols_data <- sites |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(NUMPOINTS), !is.na(ViewArea_k))

ols_model <- stats::lm(NUMPOINTS ~ ViewArea_k, data = ols_data)
ols_data$ols_residuals <- stats::residuals(ols_model)

points_for_idw <- sf::st_centroid(ols_data)
## Warning: st_centroid assumes attributes are constant over geometries
crs_for_raster <- if (!is.null(sf::st_crs(study_area)$proj4string)) {
  sf::st_crs(study_area)$proj4string
} else {
  sf::st_crs(study_area)$wkt
}

ext <- sf::st_bbox(study_area)
base_raster <- raster::raster(
  xmn = ext["xmin"], xmx = ext["xmax"],
  ymn = ext["ymin"], ymx = ext["ymax"],
  crs = crs_for_raster,
  resolution = 50
)

points_sp   <- methods::as(points_for_idw, "Spatial")
idw_model   <- gstat::gstat(formula = ols_residuals ~ 1, data = points_sp,
                            nmax = 12, set = list(idp = 2))
idw_result  <- predict(idw_model, methods::as(base_raster, "SpatialGrid"))
## [inverse distance weighted interpolation]
resid_raster <- raster::raster(idw_result, layer = "var1.pred")

raster_mean <- raster::cellStats(resid_raster, "mean")
raster_sd   <- raster::cellStats(resid_raster, "sd")

classify_by_sigma <- function(x, m, s) {
  z <- (x - m) / s
  dplyr::case_when(
    z < -2 ~ "- >2 σ",
    z < -1 ~ "- 1–2 σ",
    z <  1 ~ "± 1 σ",
    z <  2 ~ "+ 1–2 σ",
    TRUE   ~ "+ >2 σ"
  )
}

raster_df <- as.data.frame(resid_raster, xy = TRUE)
names(raster_df)[3] <- "value"
raster_df <- raster_df |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(SdCategory_OLS = classify_by_sigma(value, raster_mean, raster_sd))

ols_sigma_palette <- c(
  "- >2 σ" = "#1F5A97", "- 1–2 σ" = "#82C0D1",
  "± 1 σ" = "#FFFFFF", "+ 1–2 σ" = "#FFE66D",
  "+ >2 σ" = "#F57C35"
)
category_order <- c("- >2 σ", "- 1–2 σ", "± 1 σ", "+ 1–2 σ", "+ >2 σ")
raster_df$SdCategory_OLS <- factor(raster_df$SdCategory_OLS, levels = category_order)

p2 <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", which_north = "true",
    style = ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering,
    height = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"), width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm")
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster(data = raster_df, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, fill = SdCategory_OLS)) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(data = study_area, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = ols_sigma_palette, name = "OLS Residuals (IDW ±σ)",
    drop = FALSE, na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_void() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8)
  )

print(p1)

print(p2)
